name: Mid-America Apartment Communities

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Mid-America Apartment Communities logo.svg)

description: MAA owns and operates apartment communities across the Southeast, Southwest and Mid-Atlantic, in 16 states and DC: 293 operating communities plus 8 under construction (2,522 units, $932.0M expected cost) at Dec 31, 2025. The money is monthly apartment rent; two reported segments are Same Store (95% of NOI) and Non-Same Store and Other (new, lease-up, development and non-multifamily). It also renovates units in place (5,995 kitchens and baths in 2025 at about $6,080 each, earning about 7.0% higher rent). Biggest markets are Atlanta, Dallas, Austin, Charlotte, Orlando and Tampa.
